id.description: Unique Custodian identifier. Opaque, do not parse it.

name.description: Full legal name of the institution.

code.description: Short internal code, upper case, unique across the environment. Used on statements and feed files.

institution_type.description: Kind of institution holding the assets.
institution_type.title: InstitutionType

bic.description: SWIFT BIC, 8 or 11 characters. Null when the institution has none.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the registered entity.

contact_email.description: Operations mailbox used for reconciliation queries.

status.description:
Only `active` Custodians accept new Accounts and Payments. `suspended`
blocks new ones but leaves existing records untouched; `inactive` retires
the institution while keeping its history.
